mcqs.question:
With reference to the GST 2.0 changes effective 22 September 2025, consider the following statements:
Statement A: Individual health insurance was placed under Nil GST.
Statement B: Life-saving cancer drugs were placed under Nil GST.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: individual health insurance and life-saving cancer drugs were assigned Nil GST under the GST 2.0 changes. The alternatives are incorrect because neither item was assigned a positive GST rate in these decisions.

mcqs.question: Under the GST 2.0 health-care reforms effective 22 September 2025, what GST rate was prescribed for life-saving drugs?
mcqs.explanation: Life-saving drugs were placed under 0% GST from 22 September 2025. The 5% rate applied to most medicines, devices and diagnostics, while 18% and 40% were not the prescribed rates for life-saving drugs.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the GST changes in the health-care and wellness sectors effective 22 September 2025.

List-I
(a) Most medicines, devices and diagnostics
(b) CT scan machine
(c) Gyms, yoga, salons and wellness services
(d) Personal-care products such as soap, shampoo and toothpaste

List-II
(i) GST reduced to 5%
(ii) GST reduced from 18% to 5%
(iii) GST reduced from 18% to 5%
(iv) GST reduced from 12–18% to 5%
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv. Most medicines, devices and diagnostics were assigned 5% GST; CT scan machines moved from 18% to 5%, wellness services from 18% to 5%, and personal-care products from 12–18% to 5%.

mcqs.question: Under the GST 2.0 health-care reform package, what GST rate was imposed on sugary drinks effective 22 September 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Sugary drinks were placed in the 40% sin slab. The 5% and 18% rates applied to several other goods and services, while 28% was not the rate specified for sugary drinks in this reform.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the GST treatment of cigarettes under the health-care reform package is incorrect?
options: Cigarettes attracted 28% GST along with cess.
The effective burden on cigarettes was stated as 52–88%.
Cigarettes were placed under the 40% sin slab without the specified 28% GST and cess structure.
The cigarette-related change was effective from 22 September 2025.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that cigarettes were placed under a 40% sin slab without the 28% GST-and-cess structure. The specified treatment was 28% GST plus cess, producing an effective burden of 52–88%, with the change effective from 22 September 2025.
